machines.name: OmniPress CP-200
machines.summary: Pneumatic press controller. Front panel with status screen, power and emergency stop, run controls and menu navigation. Printed mock-up used for training demos.

history.title: Pressure sensor replaced
history.description: Recurring E-12 overpressure faults traced to a drifting pressure sensor. Sensor replaced and calibrated.

history.title: Quarterly maintenance
history.description: Air filter cleaned, seals inspected, E-STOP function tested OK.

history.title: Firmware updated to v3.4.1
history.description: Fixes false W-03 low-pressure warnings at start-up.

history.title: Commissioned
history.description: Panel installed on press line 2 and handed over to production.

issues.title: Overpressure
issues.symptom: Press stops, red LED on, screen shows E-12.
issues.cause: Line pressure above 6.5 bar, or a faulty pressure sensor.
issues.fix: Reduce supply pressure at the regulator, then clear the fault with the 'Clear fault E-12' procedure. If it returns, check the pressure sensor.

issues.title: Emergency stop engaged
issues.cause: The emergency stop button is pressed in.
issues.fix: Make the area safe, then follow 'Emergency stop reset'.

issues.title: Low pressure
issues.symptom: Amber LED, screen shows W-03, cycles are slow.
issues.cause: Supply pressure below 2.0 bar or an air leak.
issues.fix: Check the air supply and hoses for leaks. Warning clears by itself when pressure is back in range.

procedures.title: Start-up sequence
procedures.description: Power on the panel and start an automatic cycle.

steps.instruction: Check the EMERGENCY STOP is released (pulled out).
steps.expectedResult: The red mushroom button is in the up position.
The screen lights up and shows 'BOOTING'.

steps.instruction: Wait for the status screen to show READY.
steps.expectedResult: Screen shows 'READY' and the current pressure.

steps.instruction: Press MODE until the screen shows AUTO.
Press OK to confirm the mode.
Press START to begin the cycle.

procedures.title: Clear fault E-12 (overpressure)
procedures.description: Reset the panel after an overpressure fault once supply pressure is back below 6.5 bar.

steps.instruction: Press STOP to make sure the press is halted.
Check the pressure on the status screen is below 6.5 bar.
steps.expectedResult: Pressure reading is between 2.0 and 6.0 bar.

steps.instruction: Press and hold OK for 3 seconds.
steps.expectedResult: Screen shows 'E-12 CLEARED' and the red LED turns off.

procedures.title: Emergency stop reset
procedures.description: Recover after the emergency stop was used.

steps.instruction: Make sure the cause of the emergency stop is resolved and the area is safe.
Twist the EMERGENCY STOP clockwise to release it.
Check the status LEDs: only green should be on.
steps.expectedResult: Green LED on, red and amber off.
